why: B4, a plain linear quantile regression of the target-day spread on the last observed spread, the as-of reserve balances and the calendar terms of spread_mr_calendar.NO_FOMC_IORB, one fit per lead and per level of the protocol's grid (repo_model.b4_quantile_regression). Every fit trains on direct pairs (b4_quantile_regression.fit_quantile_regression carries guard_one_step_fit and takes training_pairs = direct only; repo_model.one_step_guard.ONE_STEP_ALLOW_LIST is not changed); the calendar flags are read from the target row, the scheduled settlement flags only at lead 1 where asof rule 2 admits them. No gradient-boosted fitter is called, so the study is not provisional
